_about: Expeditions into layered chasms of strange ecology, scarce supplies, and ancient relics. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

chasm: a mile-wide sinkhole ringed by whistling brass wind-towers
sunken cathedral vaults stacked beneath an inland black sea
the hollowed trunk of a petrified titan-tree lit by pale fungi
a vertical borehole lined with rusted ribs from an older sky
a split glacier dropping into steam-warmed prehistoric caverns
a salt-mine crater opening onto inverted palaces of smoked glass
the fossilized ribcage of a leviathan spanning seven buried strata
an iron oubliette whose stone rings grind into new layouts each tide
rim_town: a muddy boomtown cobbled together from salvaged dungeon shutters
a chartered guild keep taxing every hauled relic sack on brass scales
a cliffside bazaar of rope walkways dangling directly inside the mouth
a charity hospice treating depth-sick delvers in exchange for maps
a narrow-gauge railhead auctioning fresh shaft claims every dawn
a penal work-camp trading shaved prison years for third-layer salvage
a ring of lashed river-barges circling the whirlpool entrance
a snowed-in bathhouse hamlet heated by vents rising from layer one
expedition_goal: haul up enough singing amber before frost to buy back the family boat
recover a vanished sister's brass compass from the flooded fourth tier
chart a dry bypass shaft before the monopoly company claims the route
bring back a living hearth-core before winter starves the rim settlement
escort a frail linguist deep enough to read an unopened threshold gate
retrieve the camp's stolen payroll from a warren of shell-thieving crabs
clear a disgraced crew's name by recovering their last chalk logbook
carry a fallen partner's lantern down to the quiet garden they promised to see
ecology: blind lantern-beetles that mimic human calls for help around corners
velvet wall-moss that drinks lamp oil straight through sealed flasks
territorial cliff-apes wearing mismatched breastplates from dead prospectors
sweet spore-fogs that trick hungry crews into feasting on bare stones
choir-worms whose harmonic hum shatters overtired steel blades
porcelain banquet stewards still serving lethal vintage in sunken halls
warm subterranean rivers patrolled by translucent electric eels
desperate rival prospectors willing to cut an unguarded climbing line
scarcity: tallow lamps burn twice as fast once heavy damp air settles in
iron pitons rust to flakes whenever sour mist exhales from below
only a hot meal cooked from fresh cavern game wards off bone-shivers
climbing back up too quickly brings nosebleeds and waking hallucinations
every active relic hums louder the more metal your pack carries
dry kindling vanishes completely past the second milestone arch
clean drinking water down on layer three trades ounce-for-ounce with silver
braided hemp ropes rot overnight whenever luminous rain falls upward
deep_secret: the chasm is not collapsing—it is slowly digesting the surface world
every priceless relic brought up leaves a matching gap in someone's memory
rim-town's founders sealed a living bargain at the bottom eighty years ago
time drags deeper down until one week below costs a year above
the territorial beasts on layer four were once prospectors who stayed
a dormant cradle at the core is waiting for a warm hand on its helm
official guild maps erase a thriving lamp-lit settlement on layer five
the pit unseals a deeper staircase only when greed spills a friend's blood

1: the mapped route down has collapsed into an unrecorded side warren
a supply cache left on the first ledge has already been picked clean
fresh chalk marks warn that another crew went down hours ahead
a minor cave-in forces a choice between spare rations and climbing gear
2: crossing the boundary into a deeper tier changes how light and sound behave
camp for the night attracts scavengers drawn to the smell of hot food
a prized relic starts reacting violently to the chasm's pulse
a wounded survivor from an earlier crew begs not to be carried upward
3: the primary ascent shaft floods or shifts, cutting off the easy road home
depth sickness and dwindling lamp fuel turn allies suspicious
rival delvers corner the party at a narrow choke point over the drop
the ruin's deeper defenses wake up in response to disturbed treasure
4: reaching the target chamber reveals the true price of hauling the prize out
a desperate overloaded climb back toward daylight with the chasm rising behind
deciding whether to seal the lower gate forever or cash in at rim-town
the thing sleeping at the bottom offers safe passage for one stay-behind soul

cliches: torches burning brightly inside a tomb sealed for ten thousand years
gold coins minted in modern currency sitting inside prehistoric chests
a conveniently placed minecart track right to the exit
eating unidentified glowing mushrooms with zero consequences
nobody brought a single length of rope into a vertical pit
the ancient stone bridge collapses only on the last person's heel
